assertions.description: The Translator interface is exposed on Window in a secure context (on Chrome for Android from 161).
Translator.availability() and Translator.create() are static functions.
Translator.prototype exposes translate(), translateStreaming(), measureInputUsage(), destroy() and the inputQuota, sourceLanguage and targetLanguage getters.
Translator.availability({sourceLanguage:'en', targetLanguage:'es'}) resolves to one of 'available' | 'downloadable' | 'downloading' | 'unavailable', without downloading anything.
An invalid BCP 47 language tag is rejected with a RangeError during option validation.
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(typeof Translator!=='function')return false;try{await Translator.availability({sourceLanguage:'en',targetLanguage:'not a tag!'});return false;}catch(e){return e instanceof RangeError;}})()

assertions.description: targetLanguage is a required dictionary member, so omitting it rejects with a TypeError.
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(typeof Translator!=='function')return false;try{await Translator.availability({sourceLanguage:'en'});return false;}catch(e){return e instanceof TypeError;}})()

assertions.description: create() with an already-aborted AbortSignal rejects with an AbortError before any download can start.
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(typeof Translator!=='function')return false;const ac=new AbortController();ac.abort();try{await Translator.create({sourceLanguage:'en',targetLanguage:'fr',signal:ac.signal});return false;}catch(e){return e&&e.name==='AbortError';}})()

assertions.description: In an iframe whose allow attribute denies the 'translator' policy-controlled feature, availability() resolves 'unavailable' and create() rejects with NotAllowedError.
assertions.test: (async()=>{if(typeof Translator!=='function')return false;const f=document.createElement('iframe');f.setAttribute('allow',"translator 'none'");f.style.display='none';f.srcdoc='<!doctype html><title>t</title>';const l=new Promise(r=>f.addEventListener('load',r,{once:true}));document.body.append(f);await l;try{const w=f.contentWindow;const a=await w.Translator.availability({sourceLanguage:'en',targetLanguage:'fr'});let n='';try{await w.Translator.create({sourceLanguage:'en',targetLanguage:'fr'});}catch(e){n=e.name;}return a==='unavailable'&&n==='NotAllowedError';}finally{f.remove();}})()
